requirements.statement: In each set of pages, the feature leading to the site map page is at the same place in the presentation.

citations.quote: Dans chaque ensemble de pages, la fonctionnalité vers la page « plan du site » est-elle située à la même place dans la présentation ?

routes.statement: Compared with another page of the same set, the means of access to the site map is at the same place.

citations.quote: Choisir une page de l’échantillon appartenant au même ensemble que la page en cours d’audit ;
est-elle située à la même place dans la présentation ?

rationale.text: The test compares two pages of the same set, and a check runs on one target and sees one page, so it cannot make that comparison. The wording asks about the place in the presentation. The methodology of this test describes a comparison of the generated source and the relative order of elements, which is what test 12.4.3 asks, while the methodology of 12.4.3 describes the visual comparison: the two methodologies appear swapped. This entry follows the wording, and the mismatch changes nothing here, since neither comparison can be made on one page. Finding the means of access to the site map, which page is the site map, and which pages form a set, are also established by the human. No axe rule is tagged and no custom check is registered. The entry is none. Applicability is judgment: a site without a site map makes the test not applicable, which code cannot establish from the page examined. Needs is empty: the missing input is another page of the set, which no prerequisite covers.
